faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Attendant or Office Support (Male Only) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TISS Attendant or Office Support (Male Only) posts is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th Standard (HSC) from a recognized board and possess a minimum of 1 year of experience in office support or a related field.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Attendant or Office Support post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Attendant or Office Support (Male Only) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month, which includes travelling allowance.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the TISS Attendant or Office Support (Male Only) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Interaction followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Tata Institute of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q8. Can female candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: No, the post is specifically for "Male Only" as indicated in the post name.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ADVT/TISS/PROJECT/PRAYAS/August/2026.
